content.short: A high-performance decentralized derivatives exchange for options and perpetuals on a custom Ethereum Layer-2.
content.description:
Aevo is a high-performance decentralized derivatives exchange specializing in options and perpetual futures, built on a custom Ethereum Layer-2 rollup using the Optimism stack. It employs a hybrid model that combines an off-chain central limit order book for high-speed trade matching with on-chain settlement for maximum security. This architecture allows the platform to handle over 5,000 transactions per second.

Traders benefit from features like portfolio margin, which maximizes capital efficiency, and pre-launch token futures. Aevo provides a professional-grade trading experience with low fees, all while maintaining the transparency and self-custody of a decentralized platform.
